name: TP Settings

fields.label: Organization Defaults
fields.description: Fallback defaults for the primary company. For multiple legal entities, define one row per company in the Company Defaults table below. ERPNext Company, Warehouse and Cost Center records remain the source of truth.

fields.label: Default Parts Warehouse
fields.description: Source Warehouse for maintenance issues when a vehicle has no dedicated Parts Warehouse.

fields.label: Per-Company Configuration
fields.description: Add one row for each legal entity. New Vehicles and Maintenance Job Cards resolve their classification, department, cost center and parts warehouse from the matching row; tasks inherit the Vehicle company.

fields.label: Require Employee Link
fields.description: Require every Driver record to reference an Employee from ERPNext/Frappe HR.

fields.label: Require Active Employee for Active Driver
Block Assignment with Expired Licence
fields.description: Optional company-wide rule for all Driver assignments. Regulated transport tasks still require a current licence regardless of this setting.

fields.label: Block Assignment with Expired Medical Certificate
fields.description: Optional company policy for roles/activities requiring a current medical fitness certificate.

fields.label: Block Assignment with Expired Safety Training
fields.description: Optional company policy for roles/activities requiring current safety training.

fields.label: Require Brevet Professionnel for Regulated Transport
fields.description: Controls the additional professional certificate, medical fitness and negative drug-screening evidence for the five road-transport activities in Algerian Law 26-09, Articles 79–80. Disable only after the competent authority confirms the selected activity is outside scope. A current driving licence number, category and expiry remain mandatory for regulated transport even when this option is disabled.

description: Central settings for Sotrama public-works fleet operations.
